description: This file defines the MailMergeController class which extends SugarController. It handles search actions related to mail merge functionalities within the SuiteCRM platform, including querying and retrieving data for contacts, leads, and campaign prospects. The class manages search requests, processes query parameters, interacts with modules to retrieve data, and returns results in JSON format.
